notes.title: New update: Story Mode and Steam Cloud Save!
notes.notes: [p]Hello summer lovers,[/p][p]To start the school year on the right track, we're coming with [b]an update[/b]! We've carefully read your feedback and tried to respond the best we can with an update and a few guides. We've added the [b]Steam Cloud Save[/b], and a "[b]story mode[/b]" where you can't instant-win the combat![/p][p][/p][h2]Patchnote[/h2][p][b]Added[/b][/p][list][*][p]Steam Cloud Save[/p][/*][*][p]During combat, an instant win button[/p][/*][*][p]During combat, a new pop-up[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Fixed/Balancing[/b][/p][list][*][p]Increased the amount of relationship points gained to unlock relationship episodes more easily[/p][/*][*][p]Main content videos unlocked in the gallery app[/p][/*][*][p]Updated credits text[/p][/*][*][p]Removed some extra text for some sentences in the Brazilian language[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Guides[/h2][p]We've also created a few guides to help you in your stellar journey ✨[/p][p][u][b]Relationship mechanics[/b][/u][/p][p]If you're curious about how the relationship system works in Nova Hearts, here are some insights and a little explanation on how to unlock some hidden selfies and hot pics 🔥[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3537418389"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][u][b]Final boss fight[/b][/u][/p][p]We heard that our last boss (whoever it is 👀) is not the easiest to beat! So here are some tips to defeat it![/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3537474587"][/dynamiclink][/p][h2]Fan arts[/h2][p]We've also seen a few fan arts that warmed our hearts, so we also wanted to share them with you 💖[/p][p][b]Pixel Art Will by LesBeanz[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44788670/5b42237b8ccf26a10c10d075f3d32ab18402123e.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]Luce and Will by Sandra[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44788670/b31626c057f5d942e04c58d7e8a4929e21657610.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Luce and Basil by Sara[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44788670/62f72c72678b5d207e779f960b18cde7e30a1428.jpg"][/img][/p][p]We thank you for your support and very cool fan arts. Don't hesitate to write a Steam review. It helps us a lot! Have a good September everyone 👋[/p][p][/p][p]ps: yes[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44788670/6f030e4b5f32ad893ce89222b7a3ec4f7ef3f701.png"][/img][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: What's in the next update?
notes.notes:
[h3]An update is on the way for the first chapter The Spark![/h3]

We've been carefully reading your feedback and thanks to your reports and suggestions, a few things will be updated! This update will come in the first week of March.

Here is our plan for this update:
[list]
[*] Fasten the conversation in the Message App
[*] Modify the combat pacing to have fewer combats and fasten them
[*] Specify the intentions behind dialogue choices
[*] Many other quality-of-life improvements and bug fixes!
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44835526/ee86b59158ef5f035b6f376213c05b2623112fd5.png[/img]

Thanks to YOU, we can improve this game, so don't hesitate to share your feedback and suggestions in the Steam discussions.

[h3]What would you like to see improved in the game?[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44835526/56262a94a678b34caa2847e767430ae62378782b.png[/img]

notes.title: New release date for first chapter "The Spark"
notes.notes:
The first chapter [i]Nova Hearts: The Spark[/i] will be officially playable [b]for free on January 25, 4pm CET / 7am PST[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44788670/7eee66f2d605d39d3cc6a4254adc625bcf384d73.png[/img]

[h3]The full game will then be playable in [b]2025[/b].[/h3]

In this first chapter, you play Luce, a positive and funny 21yo who loves being around her friends and helping others. You're back in this city you left some years ago. Discover more about your new life, new [i]old[/i] friends, and powers!

[previewyoutube=UFjAvu_0_jw;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]Support us, don’t forget to wishlist Nova Hearts![/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2506290/Nova_hearts/

We can't wait to know what you think of the game, its characters and soul!
